name: Komugi School
description: Komugi School — a theme for a professional bakery school. A chip info bar sits directly above one huge top-down film-grain bench photograph that bleeds off the right edge beside an 82 px left rail with a rotated credit, a tilted schedule card lies on the photograph, the training week is a list of hairline Mon–Fri rows with filled and outline chips and 4:3 thumbnails, and two name tickers run in opposite directions. A near-white ground (#FAFAFA) with warm ink (#14110E) and a quiet mock-tea brown (#716454) for chips; Fraunces for reading and headings, Outfit for labels. Sample content in English (home page), more pages and languages follow. Works without WooCommerce.

fonts.role: text and display: headings, reading text, ticker names (variable, Latin subset, roman and italic)
labels: chips, menu, buttons, rail (variable, Latin subset)
